demo.banner: DEMO MODE — all data is synthetic. Nothing here is a real worker record, payment or submission.
demo.honest: The worker, payouts and documents are invented. No real worker documents are used. No external submission is made or simulated - drafts stay drafts, and nothing is sent to any platform, department or scheme.
demo.on: Demo mode is ON. Your real records are untouched.
demo.s1b: Open Log shift. The demo worker already has 14 days of synthetic shifts on two imaginary apps; add one yourself.
demo.s2b: Tap 'Use synthetic demo payout', review the figures it read, then 'Check my payout'. You will see a possible ₹160 shortfall, explained without calling it fraud.
demo.s3b: Calculate a trip and compare it with the demo worker's own average per hour.
demo.s4b: Answer the short questions. Each card shows its source, whether it is verified, and why you may or may not qualify.
demo.s5b: Create a draft from the payout evidence. Review it, edit it and set its status yourself. Nothing is submitted.
demo.s6b: See estimates, your own reports and verified outcomes kept apart. The verified column stays at ₹0 on purpose.
demo.title: Hackathon demo walkthrough
